It wasn't enough to overtake its biggest rival, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, but despite the episode airing after midnight, it tripled its 18 to 49 audience numbers from the night before and doubled what Kimmel pulled in. What's more interesting, though, is that despite the NFL season opener being down a whopping 11% from last year and delivering the lowest overall viewership since 2022, it earned the best audience of viewers 18 to 49 since 2021 – an audience that not only showed up for the season opener, but stuck around for Fallon.

At this point, it's safe to say that using sports as a creative and programmatic strategy for The Tonight Show has been a worthwhile investment. Four more Sunday Night Football takeovers are scheduled for the NFL season, and we're only weeks away from the MLB postseason and the start of new seasons for the NBA and NHL. Now that Fallon has earned the trust and respect of the most sought-after demo and the most ravenous fanbases, it'll be interesting to see what new highs he takes the oldest late-night show to next.

Image via NBC

Published Sep 17, 2026, 11:35 PM EDT

Chelsea Adelaine Hassler is an award-winning editorial, social, and creative director with two decades of media and entertainment experience and an all-consuming obsession with TV. Image via NBC

Fallon's natural talents shine best when music is involved.

As NBC Dominates Sports, 'The Tonight Show' Dominates With Sports Fans

Image via NBC

The 2025-26 television season was a big one for NBC Sports, with a slate of events including both the first NBA games since 2002 and the Winter Olympics in Milan Cortina.
